content.text:
Four additions and one change to `UnionFind`:

- **`DisjointSetFactory` interface** — declares `DisjointSet create(int size)`. The old `class` with a static method becomes a proper abstraction that can have multiple implementations.

- **`NodeFactory` interface** — declares `Node create(int index)`. This is the extension point for alternate node structures (e.g. a weighted node, a pooled node, a node carrying extra metadata) without touching `UnionFind`.

- **`DefaultNodeFactory`** — the standard implementation, creates plain `Node` objects. Passed into `UnionFind` as the default allocation strategy.

- **`DefaultDisjointSetFactory`** — implements `DisjointSetFactory`, holds a `NodeFactory`, and wires them together when calling `new UnionFind(size, nodeFactory)`. The no-arg constructor defaults to `DefaultNodeFactory`, so existing call sites need no changes.

- **`UnionFind` constructor** — now takes `(int size, NodeFactory nodeFactory)` and delegates `new Node(i)` to `nodeFactory.create(i)`. The rest of the class is unchanged; node creation is the only thing that varied.
